claims.claim: Niantic, the creator of Pokémon Go, sold the game last year and pivoted into world models using its trove of world data.
claims.episode_span: Niantic, the company behind Pokémon Go, sold the game last year and shifted its focus to building these 3D digital replicas of real places using its large collection of environment data.
claims.source_title: World Models Will Soon Be Inescapable. Here’s What You Need to Know
claims.supporting_quote: Niantic, the creator of Pokémon Go , sold the game last year and pivoted hard into one of Silicon Valley’s buzziest AI topics right now: world models.

claims.claim: Brian McClendon is chief technology officer at Niantic Spatial and describes the goal as reconstructing the real world.
claims.episode_span: Brian McClendon, chief technology officer at Niantic Spatial, describes the goal as reconstructing the real world so that robots can practice tasks in safe digital copies instead of the physical environment.
claims.source_title: World Models Will Soon Be Inescapable. Here’s What You Need to Know
claims.supporting_quote: “We’re very much about reconstructing the real world,” says Brian McClendon, Niantic Spatial’s chief technology officer.

claims.claim: Oliver Cameron, CEO of Odyssey, explains that a world model takes a visual state and predicts the next visual state.
claims.episode_span: Oliver Cameron, CEO of the AI lab Odyssey, explains the difference from language models this way: a language model predicts the next word in a sentence, while a world model predicts the next image after seeing the current one.
claims.source_title: World Models Will Soon Be Inescapable. Here’s What You Need to Know
claims.supporting_quote: “So with a language model, you have a sentence, and it will predict the next word in the sentence,” says Oliver Cameron, the CEO of Odyssey , an AI lab focused on world models. “With a world model, you give it a visual state of the world, an image, and it will then predict the next visual state of the world.”

claims.claim: The manga artist behind Vinland Saga publicly shared support for AI-generated art.
claims.episode_span: The manga artist behind Vinland Saga publicly shared support for AI-generated art, showing that even established creators see value in these new tools.
claims.supporting_quote: Creator of Vinland Saga praises AI art
